name: ERR-01 One not-found does not unlock unverified
expected_outcome: The lookup reports that the plate was not found and asks the applicant to check it; no vehicle is shown. After the request to continue, the agent still asks for a plate: it does not offer or accept unverified continuation after a single not-found and does not ask for contact details. No reply exposes an error code, HTTP status, the word API, a tool name, a price, or a policy-issued claim.

name: ERR-02 Two not-founds unlock unverified
expected_outcome: Both plates are looked up and reported not found; no vehicle is shown. After the second not-found, the agent offers to continue without verification. Accepting moves on to contact details and says a licensed agent will verify the vehicle later. The summary shows Mandatory, plate 11111111, the vehicle as not yet verified, the contacts, and add-ons not applicable. After final confirmation, End Node sends the closing with the applicant name, normalized phone, email, and an applicant-facing reference. A UUID-shaped reference is correct and is not internal diagnostic output. The closing does not claim a policy was issued. No reply exposes an error code, HTTP status, the word API, a tool name, a price, or a policy-issued claim.

name: ERR-03 Not found then a found plate recovers
